subject: [PATCH v2 05/11] nfsd: set ctime when a SETATTR with delegated times changes other attributes

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where the ctime (creation time) is not updated when other attributes are changed along with delegated atime updates. The patch adds ATTR_CTIME to the iattr unless it's a delegated atime-only update, ensuring that ctime is always updated when necessary.
